title: The feedback inbox skips a subagent's hand-back
why: Coordinator 2, Oct 30 17:18 CDT: seen in lanes page-answer-send (10 blocks), c104 (6) and roadmap-matches-lanes. Seen twice more in the coordinator, Oct 31 15:10 CDT.
note: Lane started Oct 31 15:12 CDT (coordinator); it promotes note feedback-guard-agent-burst (docs/debts/notes.md) to a debt record and fixes the cause. Debt: hooks/local_time.py saves each subagent hand-back (an agent-message block) to the feedback inbox as an owner message, so feedback_guard blocks each Stop until it is jotted. Fix: the inbox records only the owner's own messages. Done check: a turn that receives a subagent hand-back adds no inbox entry. Needs no answer.
